date_convention: Arrival-dated -- a leg is attributed to the date the destination stint's own book_in_date_time falls on, matching build_edge_bins.py's own convention for this project's timeline.
floor_caveat: Straight-line (WGS84 geodesic) distance is a FLOOR for road travel, not an estimate -- real road distance typically runs 1.2-1.4x the straight line. Never present this figure as 'distance travelled.'
adjusted_caveat: Circuity-adjusted estimate: legs the existing travel-mode inference (data/transfer_modes.json) classifies as road-like are multiplied by CIRCUITY_FACTOR=1.3 (a stated point estimate, not independently re-derived); air-like legs are left unadjusted, since a flight already approximates a great-circle path. Legs with no mode match are also left unadjusted (reported separately as 'undetermined_km' coverage), not guessed.
arrest_leg_caveat: The arrest-to-first-detention leg is EXCLUDED from path_km_floor/adjusted above -- its coordinates are a Census Gazetteer city-internal point, coarser than most facility-to-facility legs, which mostly resolve to a real address. See path_km_floor_with_arrest for the alternative total.
circuity_sensitivity_caveat: Total adjusted miles recomputed at the 1.2x and 1.4x ends of the same road-circuity literature range CIRCUITY_FACTOR's 1.3x midpoint is drawn from, road-classified legs only, air-like and undetermined legs unchanged -- shows how much the adjusted total actually moves with this assumption.
